David's Ice Cream Game

In loving memory of David Kornreich, Ph.D.

Made from a story Andrea shared about a game David wrote for Andrea and Brian in the 1980s.

One lovely scoop. Eat it, or try your luck?

A little higher might be just right…

How high can you go?

Delicious!

Keyboard: A adds a scoop · E eats the cone

Your cone has 1 scoop.

How to play

  1. Your cone begins with one scoop.
  2. Choose Add a scoop to build higher—but each new scoop makes the whole stack more likely to topple.
  3. Choose Eat this cone while it is still standing, and every scoop on it counts toward your score.
  4. If it topples, you lose that cone and eat no scoops that round.
